show.description: Girdhar Balwani, a star insurance agent, secretly runs a crore-rupee scam using fake policies on vulnerable people. When colleague Ramesh discovers this, Girdhar murders him. As ASP Ajay Sinha investigates—complicated by his engagement to Girdhar's crush Mohini—the agent manipulates everyone. But Jishina Mandal, whose father was a victim, uncovers the truth and brings him to justice.
